questions.q: What is the meaning of Crochetting in fabric crafts?
options: The art of decorating fabrics by stitching on beads.
A method of creating a patterned fabric by interlocking loops of yarn using a single hooked tool.
The process of carving decorative patterns on wood.
The tying of yarn to resist dye penetration.
questions.explain: Crochetting is a needlecraft where a continuous thread or yarn is hooked into intertwined loops to form a fabric, garments, or decorative items.

questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which fundamental tool distinguishes crocheting from knitting?
questions.explain: The primary tool for crocheting is a single slender stick with a hook at the end, unlike knitting which uses two or more pointed needles.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Textile Crafts, Packaging & Art Marketing
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: A major technical difference between the mechanics of knitting and crocheting is that:
options: Crocheting uses paper strips, while knitting uses wool.
Knitting keeps an entire row of stitches active on the needle simultaneously, while crocheting typically completes one stitch before starting the next.
Crocheting requires heavy machinery, whereas knitting is only done by hand.
Knitting involves gluing yarn together, whereas crocheting involves melting yarn.
questions.explain: In knitting, a row of live loops is held on the needle at once. In traditional crocheting, there is usually only one active, live loop on the hook at a time.

questions.q: What is the primary material required to perform both knitting and crocheting?
questions.explain: Both textile crafts rely on continuous strands of soft fiber, such as yarn, wool, or specialized crocheting thread, to form fabrics.

questions.q: In crocheting, the basic foundational stitch that forms the starting row of a project is called a:
questions.explain: The chain stitch is the most basic crochet stitch. It serves as the foundation (base chain) upon which the rest of the project is built.
